diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~20% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.064), which favours a robust combination.
